title: The Wet Coat Too Long for the Peg

moral: Noticing who is tired is already a gentle skill.
summary: At a library return desk and the rainy steps, a wet coat that would not stay on its peg is awkward for one person. Noemi notices Mr. Ade struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
